description: Take-home pay for an employee in Italy from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: IRPEF 23/33/43% (2026) with the employee credit and cuneo fiscale; Regional surtax for six regions, municipal surtax with its exemption; Dependent spouse credit; Pension fund deduction; Impatriati regime 50%/60%; Assegno unico minimum, TFR and employer INPS.

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in EUR, without bonus

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

municipal.description: Municipal surtax rate. Milan 0.8%, Rome 0.9%. Set by each comune. (%). Default 0.8.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

region.description: Region: lombardy = Lombardy (Milan); lazio = Lazio (Rome); piedmont = Piedmont (Turin); veneto = Veneto (Venice, Verona); tuscany = Tuscany (Florence); campania = Campania (Naples). Default lombardy.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in EUR, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Italy (2026)
